title: Frank was a great guide
text:
Frank was a great guide - friendly, funny, knowledgeable & well-informed. We really enjoyed the visit to the monestery and the walk.
Be warned, though, it was VERY cold in February - there was snow on the Pyrenees and an icy blast blew from them.
author: June_W

title: Hilly Monserrat
text: Jordin was an excellent guide and driver. He was so well informed, fun to listen to and very helpful. The monastery is lo and the walk diwn very interesting.vely, the funicular ride exciting
author: Barbara_B

title: A great half day tour of Minsewat
text: Fantastic day tour we did the walk up from Montserrat as well as the monastery tour. The walk up the mountain was a little steep but well worth it for the views. A great day out.
author: WayneR923

title: I recommend
text: Guides Jordi and Frank were excellent. Frank led the “long hike” which is up and down, which my husband did. Jordi led the “short hike”which is train going up and walk going down. Just the right amount of talking. Guides brought water and hiking poles just in case, and sure enough, some did not bring enough water. Be sure to bring water and sunblock.
author: Aurora_B

title: This tour is amazing
text: This tour is amazing and Fermin was a great host. Stunning views over the mountain. Everyone visiting Barcelona MUST go. The guide knew the trails in and out and answered so many questions.
author: 63avaw
